hook.name: HookuidityHookV1
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for creator token launches that charges a 2% fee on ETH buys (injected as pool liquidity via poolManager.donate()) and a 2% fee on ETH sells (directed to a per-pool creator reward vault), with a 0.10% launcher platform share deducted from each. Pools must be registered by the token creator before swaps can execute.
